explanation: The falls sit on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe, far from Lake Victoria, which feeds the Nile. Locally they are called Mosi-oa-Tunya, the smoke that thunders.

claims.text: Victoria Falls is on the Zambezi River.
Victoria Falls is not on the Nile, Congo or Limpopo.
Victoria Falls lies on the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe.
Lake Victoria is a source of the Nile and lies far from Victoria Falls.
Victoria Falls is known locally as Mosi-oa-Tunya, which means the smoke that thunders.
